name: After § 4
title: REPORT on a draft regulation of the European Parliament amending Decision 2005/684/EC, Euratom adopting the Statute for Members of the European Parliament, as regards proxy voting
part_text: 4a. Invites further reflection on how the different realities of parenthood beyond childbirth can be adequately accommodated, so as to ensure that Members can fully exercise their parliamentary mandate while caring for a child in early parenthood;
